Brocacef is
a major Dutch healthcare and pharmacy service provider that supplies medical equipment, including continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) and remote patient monitoring devices, rather than manufacturing consumer smartwatches or standalone wearable ECG gadgets
FreeStyle Libre
Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) & Remote Monitoring
Medical CGMs:
Brocacef supplies prescription-based, minimally invasive continuous glucose tracking systems (such as Abbott's
FreeStyle Libre
series) that use a small subcutaneous filament to measure interstitial fluid glucose 24/7.
GlucoRx Vixxa 2 CGM
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
They facilitate pharmacy-to-patient digital care pathways, supplying connected medical hardware that transmits vital signs securely to clinical teams for chronic disease management.
Smartwatches, Wearables, and Market Realities
Smartwatches & Non-Invasive Glucose:
While numerous online marketplaces market smartwatches claiming "non-invasive blood glucose monitoring," medical consensus and regulatory bodies note that wrist-worn optical/PPG sensors cannot reliably or continuously measure actual blood sugar.
Nutrisense
Wearable ECG & Sleep Trackers:
Consumer smartwatches feature legitimate single-lead ECG and photoplethysmography (PPG) for heart rate or sleep tracking, but these lifestyle devices are distinct from clinical-grade remote monitoring ecosystems distributed by institutional healthcare providers like Brocacef.
